chat.welcomeMessage:
Nnọọ! 👋 Mụ bụ onye nkwado ugbo gị.

M nwere ike inyere gị aka na:
• Ihe ọkụkụ, akwụkwọ nri, mkpụrụ osisi, na okooko osisi
• Ịzụ anụ ụlọ, ọkụkọ, na azụ
• Njikwa ahụhụ na ọrịa
• Ndụmọdụ ihu igwe na ahịa

Kedu ka m ga-esi nyere gị aka taa?

agrivision.name: AgriVision
agrivision.tagline: Chọpụta na gbaa ọrịa osisi site na AI
agrivision.description: Nyochaa foto osisi iji chọpụta ọrịa, ahụhụ, na mgbọrọgwụ nri na-ezughị ezu. Nweta nchoputa ngwa ngwa na ndụmọdụ ọgwụgwọ na mgbochi.

isdaSoil.name: ISDA Soil
isdaSoil.tagline: Njirimara ala na nyocha nri maka Africa
isdaSoil.description: Nweta ozi ala zuru ezu gụnyere pH, nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, na nri ndị ọzọ. Mpụta gụnyere Africa niile na mkpebi mita 30.

accuweather.name: AccuWeather
accuweather.tagline: Ọnọdụ na amụma ihu igwe ugbu a n'ụwa niile
accuweather.description: Nweta data ihu igwe ozugbo gụnyere okpomọkụ, iru mmiri, ọsọ ifufe, na mmiri ozuzo. Amụma dị ihe ruru ụbọchị 15.

gapWeather.name: GAP Weather
gapWeather.tagline: Amụma ihu igwe ọrụ ugbo maka Kenya
gapWeather.description: Amụma ihu igwe pụrụ iche maka ọrụ ugbo na Kenya. Gụnyere evapotranspiration, radieshon anyanwụ, na amụma mmiri ozuzo e mere maka mkpebi ọrụ ugbo.

edacap.name: EDACaP Climate
edacap.tagline: Amụma ihu igwe oge maka Ethiopia
edacap.description: Amụma ihu igwe oge gụnyere amụma okpomọkụ na mmiri ozuzo. Na-enyere ndị ọrụ ugbo aka ịhazi oge ịkụ ihe na iwe ihe ubi.

weatherapi.name: WeatherAPI
weatherapi.tagline: Data ihu igwe maka ebe niile n'ụwa
weatherapi.description: Ọrụ data ihu igwe zuru oke na-enye ọnọdụ ugbu a na amụma maka ebe niile n'ụwa.

tomorrowIo.name: Tomorrow.io
tomorrowIo.tagline: Ọgụgụ isi na amụma ihu igwe
tomorrowIo.description: Nnukwu ikpo okwu ọgụgụ isi ihu igwe nwere amụma dị elu na ike amụma ozugbo.

feedFormulation.name: Ịgwakọta Nri
feedFormulation.tagline: Ịgbakọ nri kacha mma maka ehi mmiri ara ehi
feedFormulation.description: Gbakọọ ngwakọta nri kacha ọnụ ahịa maka ehi mmiri ara ehi gị. Na-eburu n'uche ebumnuche mmepụta mmiri ara ehi, ibu ahụ, na nri mpaghara dị.

nextgen.name: Nri Fatịlaịza NextGen
nextgen.tagline: Ndụmọdụ fatịlaịza akọwapụtara ebe maka Ethiopia
nextgen.description: Nweta ndụmọdụ fatịlaịza ziri ezi dabere na ebe ị nọ. Gụnyere ma ndụmọdụ organic (compost, vermicompost) na inorganic (Urea, NPS).

decisionTree.name: Osisi Mkpebi Ubi
decisionTree.description: Nweta ndụmọdụ njikwa ihe ubi dabere na oge uto na ọnọdụ ihu igwe ugbu a. Na-enyere gị aka ime mkpebi oge maka nchịkwa ahụhụ, ịgbara mmiri, na iwe ihe ubi.

gapAgriculture.name: Ọrụ Ugbo GAP
gapAgriculture.description: Ọrụ ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo n'ozuzu maka njikwa ihe ubi na anụ ụlọ.
